title: Nat call deck, Mon 28 Sep
rules: Check both calendars before offering any date.
Never restate a fee already agreed.

venues.quote: 10 Sep: £275 for 2×1h or £375 for 3×45 (£250/£350 if they book 4). Then on 14 Sep: £250 for Thu 22 Oct, 7-9pm (2×1h), with a nudge on 17 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: Holly asked the price for a Thursday 7-9pm and whether Jake is free on Thu 22 Oct.
venues.daysNote: Jake phoned on Fri 18 Sep and Holly was due to confirm on Mon 21 Sep. Nothing has come in since.
venues.why: She named the date herself, the price is in line with what she asked, and the gig is 3½ weeks away. One call gets a yes or no on 22 Oct. (Board rule: no email chase, so phone is the agreed route. Confirm 22 Oct is still clear.)

venues.quote: 4 Sep: £250 for a 2h show or £375 for 3h, Sunday afternoon, with the Oct-Dec free Sundays listed. Chased 11 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: She hadn't forgotten; she was busy and away and would get back "next week".
venues.why: She asked for a Sunday afternoon, and Sundays are what Jake has free in 2026 (a Christmas Sunday on 6, 20 or 27 Dec is an easy yes). She is now about 10 days past her own "next week". Local.

venues.quote: On 17 Sep they offered £250 for Sat 3×45, 9pm-12am, paid by bank transfer on invoice. We countered the same day: £250 cash or £275 on the books for 2×1h, and £350 cash or £375 on the books for 3 sets.
venues.lastMsg: They always want new acts for Saturday nights in the Members Bar and pay £250 for 3×45 by bank transfer.
venues.why: They have already named a budget and a slot, so only the format and fee gap is left. A call can settle a number (for example 2×1h at £275 on invoice) and fix Sat 7 Nov or a 2027 Saturday. Give the chase 24-48h first.

venues.quote: 18 Sep: £300 cash or £330 on the books for Sunday 4.30-6.30 (2×1h). We also asked for her budget.
venues.lastMsg: Claire asked what Jake charges for 2 hours on a Sunday, saying they are a small members club that watches its budget.
venues.why: Her Sunday slot fits the free 2026 Sundays. We already asked her budget, so a call gets her number and a date.

venues.quote: 21 Sep: £300 cash for 2×1h or £450 cash for 3×1h (£250/£400 each if they book 4), with the full Sat/Sun free list.
venues.lastMsg: Mel asked "What is your rate please?"
venues.why: Silence after a fee question usually means price hesitation. A call can offer the 4-date rate or a single Sunday and fix a date.

venues.quote: 17 Sep: £250 cash or £280 on the books for 2×1h, or £225 a night if they book 4. Two date lists were sent that day.
venues.lastMsg: "Ok sounds good": they asked which Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons are free.
venues.why: They accepted the fee and asked for dates, so they only need to pick one. This is the warmest quote on the list. But Jake set a HARD HOLD on 17 Sep (no further contact after two emails that day), so get Jake's OK before Natalie phones.

venues.quote: 17 Sep: £300 cash for 2×1h as a one-off, or £250 a night if they book 4. Saturday evening or Sunday afternoon.
venues.lastMsg: Terry asked the price for Saturday 8.30-9.30 and 10-11, and for Sunday 4-5 and 5.30-6.30.
venues.why: He gave exact set times for both days, and Sundays are free in 2026. A call finds out whether £300 versus £250×4 is the sticking point. Ask for Terry.
venues.note: Club line. Terry's own number is not in the files.

venues.quote: 28 Sep: Saturday only, £300 for 2×1h or £400 for 3×45 as a single night; £250/£350 a night for 2 or more dates. All-in including travel, "open to discuss". Seven free Saturdays were listed, from 7 Nov 2026 to 27 Mar 2027.
venues.lastMsg: They have a limited budget and asked Jake's charges and singing times for a Friday or Saturday evening.
venues.why: They came to us with a budget question and we said we're open to discuss. A call gets their figure. It is FAR, so Saturday only. Wait until Wed or Thu at the earliest (Haggle planned day 7 as ~Mon 5 Oct).

venues.quote: 9 Sep: £250 for 2×45, £375 for 3×45 or £485 for 4×40, with a £50 deposit. Oct-Nov dates were listed.
venues.lastMsg: Ahmet invited Jake to the restaurant to talk and gave his mobile. Jake spoke with him on 9 Sep.
venues.why: The owner asked to talk and already knows Jake. It's local, so a call or visit can pick a date.

venues.quote: 14 Sep: £285 for 2×1h or £385 for 3×45, Sat/Sun (£250/£350 if they book several). Chased 21 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: Thanks for the information, "we will be in touch".
venues.why: The GM has engaged twice. Offer a Sunday in Nov or Dec. The board says no second email chase, so the phone is the only nudge left.

venues.quote: 10 Sep: £250 cash or £280 on the books for 2×1h (8-11). Sharon accepted £250 cash and asked for 28 Aug (2027), which Jake can't do. Other August weekends were offered, and we chased on 17 Sep.
venues.lastMsg: "I will get back to you, just need to juggle some things around."
venues.why: The price is agreed and only the date is open. This is 2027 money. Do not restate the fee (NEVER_AGAIN #25).
venues.note: Fee already agreed. Do not restate the fee on the call.

venues.quote: No fee sent. Natalie moved the price conversation to the phone.
venues.lastMsg: Jaela loves Jake's sound and is definitely open to booking. She is busy with events for about 2 months and asked for rates, set lengths and a contact number.
venues.why: She asked for a call and for prices, and her busy spell ends around early November.
venues.note: The +44 7523 924644 in haggle-muddy-duck is Natalie's number that we gave Jaela, not Jaela's.

venues.quote: 8 Sep: £250 cash for 2h or £375 for 3h (2×45 or 3×45).
venues.lastMsg: She was away and would check the diary on her return and send dates.
venues.why: She asked for fees and promised dates, and it's now 3 weeks on. However, the 28 Sep status counts say "HOLD away (Jake HARD, no chase)", so confirm with Jake first.

venues.quote: 23 Sep, after Jake spoke to her by phone: £250 cash for 3×45, with a 2027 Sat/Sun list (Jake is not booking there in 2026).
venues.lastMsg: We sent the fee and full date list as promised after the call. No reply yet.
venues.why: Jake already has a phone relationship with her, so a follow-up call can pick the first 2027 date. Haggle's chase unlocks ~Tue 30 Sep.

venues.quote: 28 Aug: £400 for Sat 3×45. On 11 Sep we offered Dec Sundays (6/20/27) and 2027 Saturdays.
venues.lastMsg: Christine will take the dates to the committee, which meets on the first Tuesday of every month.
venues.why: The committee meets Tue 6 Oct, so call on Wed 7 Oct for the decision. A Christmas Sunday would be 2026 money.

venues.lastMsg: She loved it, would put it to the committee and asked for Saturdays.
venues.why: The committee met on 7 Sep, so call for the verdict; Sat 7 Nov is the only free 2026 Saturday.

venues.quote: £325 cash for Sunday 2×1h or £450 for 3×1h (16 Sep).
venues.lastMsg: Will review free Sundays next year and wants one Sunday only.
venues.why: They intend to book one, so a call gets the 2027 date.

venues.quote: £400 for one Sat of 3 sets, or £350 each for 4 (16 Sep).
venues.lastMsg: Julie asked the fee for Sat 8.30-11.30, 3 sets.
venues.why: Test her budget; 10 Oct in that quote is now taken.

venues.lastMsg: Her web form said she wants to book, asked for prices and can't give a date yet.
venues.why: The outcome of the Wed 16 Sep callback was never logged, so ask Jake first, then call for a date.

flags.text: WAIT: ask Jake about the Sandra call first

venues.quote: £300 cash (£330 on the books) for 2h or £450 for 3h, Sat/Sun (15 Sep).
venues.lastMsg: She asked "What's the fee please?"
venues.why: Silent since the quote and FAR; a call checks whether the fee is the problem.

venues.lastMsg: Mags asked the Saturday-night charge.
venues.why: 2027 only, FAR (Wales).

venues.lastMsg: Kate said Peter books the bands. Jake spoke to Peter on 14 Sep and he was going to look at the site.
venues.why: Call Peter for a date and give the price.

venues.lastMsg: She'll take it to the committee at the end of October.
venues.why: Call only after that committee (board says no chase before then); money is tight because of building works, so likely 2027.

venues.lastMsg: Fully booked for 2026 and will look at 2027 "in the next couple of months"; last reply "Will do".
venues.why: His 2027 planning window is now.

venues.contact: Kinde Hanspal (Sec), passes to Richard Cripps (ents)

venues.why: Ask for Richard.

venues.lastMsg: Nothing free this year; next year's diary starts soon.
venues.why: Local; call in about 2 weeks to be first into 2027.

venues.why: Ask for Kate.

venues.lastMsg: "Suitable, but not booking acts right now; will keep your details"
venues.why: She works Mon/Thu 08:30-13:30 only; the board says do not chase. Low.

venues.lastMsg: He'll discuss it at the October committee (our cold went out today 14:21).
venues.why: Call after the October committee.

venues.quote: No fee; they offered a ticket-keep deal (bar minimum £300 Sun-Thu).
venues.lastMsg: Sundays 18/25 Oct and 15 Nov are open.
venues.why: Only worth calling to turn it into a flat fee (Jake rejects ticket deals), and the fee-or-walk draft is waiting for Jake. 8 Nov is blocked.
venues.note: Never agree a ticket or door deal. Cash or books fee only.
